description: Calls PATCH /v1/sequences/{name}. Only the provided fields (currentValue, step) are changed; fields you omit are left as-is. Use this when you need to set an explicit `currentValue` (e.g. resetting a counter) or change the `step` amount — use jsonfabrica_bump_sequence instead when you just want to advance the sequence by its existing configured step. This overwrites the sequence's stored state in place immediately; there is no undo.

currentValue.description: Resets the sequence's current counter value to this number, without changing `step`. Optional; if omitted, the current value is left unchanged (unless `step` is also provided, in which case only `step` changes).

name.description: Exact name of the sequence to update. Required.

step.description: Changes the increment applied by future jsonfabrica_bump_sequence calls; must be a non-zero finite number (negative allowed, to count down). Optional; if omitted, the existing step is left unchanged.

name: jsonfabrica_update_sequence

currentValue.description: Current stored counter value (unused by "uuid" sequences).

start.description: Initial value the sequence was created with.

type.description: Value kind produced on each bump.

title: Update a JsonFabrica sequence
